description: Delete OpenShift resources with comprehensive safety checks, validation, and error handling

all.description: Delete all resources of the specified type

confirm.description: Require explicit confirmation for destructive operations

dryRun.description: Show what would be deleted without actually deleting

filename.description: Path to YAML file to delete resources from

gracePeriodSeconds.description: Grace period for deletion in seconds

ignore404.description: Ignore 404 errors if resource does not exist

manifest.description: YAML manifest defining resources to delete

name.description: Name of the resource to delete

url.description: URL to YAML manifest defining resources to delete
